name: Proofreading (LanguageTool)
author: Bulwark Mail Community
description: Underlines spelling, grammar and style mistakes while you write, with suggestions to fix them. Sends the text you write to the LanguageTool server your administrator set up (self-hosted, or the public api.languagetool.org only if the administrator allows it). Nothing is sent while a message is set to be signed or encrypted.

serverUrl.label: LanguageTool server
serverUrl.description: Address of your LanguageTool server, for example https://languagetool.example.com or http://languagetool:8010. Leave empty if you have none. An http or private address only works when it is listed in PLUGIN_PROXY_PRIVATE_ORIGINS on the webmail server.

accessToken.label: Access token (optional)
accessToken.description: Sent to your server as a bearer token, for a server behind an authenticating proxy. Never sent to the public API. LanguageTool Premium keys don't work here.

allowPublicApi.label: Use the public LanguageTool API when no server is set
allowPublicApi.description: Sends what users write to api.languagetool.org (LanguageTool GmbH). Meant for trying the plugin out: the free API allows 20 requests and 75 KB a minute per IP address, and all users of this webmail share one.

level.label: Default level
level.description: Picky also points out style and typography. Users may change it unless you lock it below.

defaultLanguage.label: Default language
defaultLanguage.description: auto detects the language of each check, or a code such as de-DE or en-GB. A writing language the user picked in Bulwark comes first.

preferredVariants.label: Preferred variants
preferredVariants.description: Which variant a language is spelt in, comma separated, for example de-DE,en-GB,pt-BR. Without one, English is checked as en-US, German as de-DE and Portuguese as pt-PT.

disabledRules.label: Rules turned off for everyone
disabledRules.description: LanguageTool rule ids, comma separated, for example WHITESPACE_RULE,EN_QUOTES.

disabledCategories.label: Categories turned off for everyone
disabledCategories.description: LanguageTool category ids, comma separated, for example TYPOGRAPHY,STYLE.

wordList.label: Organisation word list
wordList.description: Company and product names and other words that are spelt right, one per line. Added to every user's own dictionary. A word in lower case also matches with capitals.

userMayChange.label: Users may change language, level and turned-off rules
userMayChange.description: When off, users see these settings read-only and the plugin ignores their own choices for them. Their dictionary and the send warning stay theirs.
